name: @pipeworx/mcp-ashby

tools.name: ashby_list_candidates
tools.description: Search candidates in your ATS. Returns names, emails, and application metadata. Use ashby_get_candidate with ID for full profile details.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: ashby_get_candidate
tools.description: Get full candidate profile by ID. Returns contact info, resume, interview history, and current application status.

tools.name: ashby_list_jobs
tools.description: Search open positions. Filter by status (open, closed, draft, archived). Returns job title, department, and posting details.

status.description: Filter by job status: Open, Closed, Draft, Archived

tools.name: ashby_get_job
tools.description: Get full job posting by ID. Returns description, requirements, hiring stage, and applicant count.

tools.name: ashby_list_applications
tools.description: Search job applications across positions. Returns candidate name, applied job, application stage, and submission date.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ashby forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ashby pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
